<thought>To locate a suitable carbonyl‑ene retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using only the functional group criteria (breaking a ketone and a C‑C double bond, forming an aliphatic hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring). This avoids the need to specify exact bond index strings.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
